name: The Great Dalmuti
description: The Great Dalmuti is a shedding game by Richard Garfield (Wizards of the Coast, 1995) for 4â€“8 players. 80 cards: one 1, two 2s â€¦ up to twelve 12s, plus two Jesters (wild). Get rid of all cards; first out is Greater Dalmuti next round. Play sets of equal rank; each new play must be lower rank; pass if unable. When all but one pass, that player leads next. Seating by draw: Greater/Lesser Dalmuti, Greater/Lesser Peon. Peons give lowest cards to Dalmutis (who return any). Reseat after each hand by finish order.
